articles.title: U.S. SEC proposes first major crypto rule in surprise announcement
articles.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission issued the "Regulation Crypto" proposal after having cancelled a meeting days before meant to vote on it.

articles.title: Wyoming joins $15 billion LayerZero exodus with state stablecoin move
articles.description: This is the first time a U.S. government entity has publicly replaced its blockchain infrastructure specifically on security grounds.

articles.title: Bitcoin has gone quiet as traders chase ‘5x or 10x’ payoffs elsewhere
articles.description: Bitcoin's price swings have hit a cycle low, squeezed by a market tug-of-war with no clear winner. The traders who once lived off its chaos have taken their risk appetite elsewhere.

articles.title: Kraken adds U.S. stocks in Europe as TradFi-crypto divide blurs
articles.description: The exchange said it is the first crypto company to offer European customers both traditional U.S. equities and tokenized versions of those assets on a single regulated platform.

articles.title: Why the Trump-backed crypto venture is distancing itself from Hong Kong AI aggregator WorldClaw
articles.description: WLFI says the AI platform is independent and uses USD1 as a payment rail, but would not say whether it has equity, financing, revenue-sharing or other economic interests in the company.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners’ AI pivot pays off, but mining could revive with one twist
articles.description: Miners with AI and high-performance computing contracts have commanded higher valuations as declining bitcoin prices and hashprice squeeze pure-play operators.

articles.title: Global bond yields surge as debt fears test bitcoin’s hedge narrative

articles.title: Japan's Metaplanet launching U.S. bitcoin treasury company through $135 million nanocap deal
articles.description: The deal involves Metaplanet contributing 2,100 bitcoin and $2.5 million in cash, valuing the initial investment at $134.6 million.

articles.title: HashKey taps Hong Kong's first regulated stablecoin to settle insurance and trade deals
articles.description: Following institutional trials, the HKD-pegged asset is being put to work to capture part of Hong Kong's $49 billion trade corridor with the United Arab Emirates

articles.title: Citi plans to launch bitcoin custody for institutional clients later this year
articles.description: The Wall Street bank plans to let clients hold bitcoin alongside traditional assets through its new Custody+ platform.

articles.title: Crypto’s easy-money era is ending in a wave of failures
articles.description: Inflated valuations and weak business models are driving crypto’s shakeout, Global Settlement Network CEO Ryan Kirkley says.

articles.title: Cash App's crypto support expands beyond bitcoin and USDC via MoonPay

articles.title: Visa looking for new stablecoin settlement partner after BVNK sale to Mastercard
articles.description: Visa’s request for product (RFP) talks about the need to support a range of stablecoins.

articles.title: Ethereum’s next upgrade breaks the '21,000 gas' rule wallets rely on
articles.description: Sending ETH to a brand-new address will cost more than sending to an existing one, and software built around a flat fee will get the sum wrong.

articles.title: The 'crack' in the energy market is wider than ever. Bitcoin might feel it.
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Aug. 18 2026

articles.title: South Korea joins more than 30 jurisdictions restricting Polymarket access
articles.description: Regulators rejected Polymarket's defense regarding its P2P nature, arguing the platform manages market rules and facilitates crypto-based gambling activity.

articles.title: Bitcoin pauses at $64,000 as rising yields, oil drag equities lower

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin tepidly on the rise as stocks slip

articles.title: The bitcoin price level where leveraged bulls could get whacked
articles.description: Bulls are stacking longs, liquidity is thinning and one key level could trigger large liquidations.

articles.title: XRP sinks below $1 for first time since 2024 even as Korean bank adopts Ripple Payments
articles.description: Jeonbuk Bank will use Ripple’s 24/7 cross-border payment service for business remittances, but it is unknown whether the flows will use XRP or Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin.

articles.title: Monad, an Ethereum rival, offered early investors up to $60 million to cash out. Almost all said no
articles.description: The program came three months before investor unlocks begin, with MON trading below its public-sale price and most of the token supply still outside circulation.

articles.title: Bitcoin climbs above $64,000 while most majors slip

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward joins Anthropic’s Project Glasswing for AI security push

articles.title: Saylor says share buyback isn’t priority as Strategy builds $4.8 billion cash reserve
articles.description: Strategy is prioritizing STRC, cash reserves, and its credit business over stock buybacks, Executive Chairman Michael Saylor said Monday.
